snippet.title: Hash Code 2020: Online Qualification Round Livestream
snippet.description:
The Hash Code 2020 Online Qualification Round will take place on Thursday, February 20th from 17h30 to 21h30 UTC. Learn more at https://g.co/hashcode

Post a selfie of yourself tuning in to the livestream on social media with the hashtag #HashCode, or email the photo to hashcode@google.com, for a chance to be featured in the closing livestream! Terms apply: https://goo.gl/EknGfn

Hash Code is a team programming competition, organized by Google, for students and professionals around the world. You pick your team and programming language and we pick an engineering problem for you to solve. This year’s contest kicks off with an Online Qualification Round, where your team can compete from wherever you’d like, including from one of our Hash Code hubs. Top teams will then be invited to a Google office for the Final Round.

snippet.title: Hash Code 2020: Apply to host a hub today!
snippet.description:
Google's team programming competition, #HashCode, will be back for another year of competition fun in 2020. Registration to compete opens in January, but you can already sign up to host a hub at g.co/hashcode.

Hubs are volunteer-organized meetups where teams from the same university, office, coworking space, or local area can come together to compete in the Online Qualification Round side-by-side. Hubs are a great way to meet new people and build a developer community...but don't take our word for it! Hear past hub organizers explain why they wanted to organize a hub and what the experience was like for them.

Learn more & apply to host a hub today: g.co/hashcode

snippet.title: Code Jam 2019 World Finals in San Francisco, CA - Highlight Reel
snippet.description:
The #CodeJam 2019 World Finals concluded in San Francisco on Friday, August 9. The top contestants gathered in one room to solve six complex algorithmic puzzles over the course of four hours. In the end, Gennady Korotkevich of Belarus was crowned as the six time reigning Code Jam champion.

Watch the full livestream of the Code Jam Finals, complete with commentary from Code Jam engineers → https://youtu.be/biyvpvx9I7E
